Overview

Incheon is a city in INC with a population of 2,978,000. Korea’s gateway city with Asia’s largest airport, a growing tech hub, and the vibrant Songdo International Business District. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
